newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage fell 6.20 million barrels in the week ended Sept 27 to 302.28 million barrels from a revised 308.48 million barrels that was previously reported as 306.91 million in the prior week, the American Petroleum Institute (API) said Tuesday.
API said that crude stocks excluding PADD 5 (Petroleum Administration for Defense District) fell 3.00 million barrels in the week to 233.59 million barrels.
Distillate stocks fell 17,000 barrels to 112.34 million from 112.36 million the previous week. However, PADD 1 distillate stocks rose 313,000 barrels to 38.76 million barrels.
API said gasoline stocks rose 2.27 million barrels in the week to 197.13 million barrels from 194.86 million barrels.
API said reformulated gasoline stocks (RFG) rose 1.02 million barrels to 40.26 million barrels from 39.24 million barrels in the previous week.
API said crude runs to processing units rose to 14.53 million barrels from 14.52 million barrels. Percent of capacity was unchanged at 95.5 percent.
Residual fuel stocks in the latest week rose to 36.04 million barrels from 35.77 million in the previous week, and crude oil imports fell to 6.54 million barrels per day from 7.30 million, API said.
